label: Ordinary actual causation versus a direct cause-in-esse support map
term: ordinary actual causation versus a direct cause-in-esse support map
resolution: ActualCauseSupportsEsse maps every ordinary Ontic.Causes edge with present endpoints to R at the selected world. ActualEsseCausesSupportAt instead maps only a supplied CausesIn-at-esse edge between numerically distinct present endpoints to R; it makes no assertion about other ordinary event-causal edges. The direct interface can be obtained by composing a cause-in-esse-to-ordinary-cause map with the stronger ordinary-cause-to-R map, but it does not itself require those two interfaces. Neither interface supplies cause presence, identifies R with conservation, or proves metaphysical applicability.
